The '''Gungan crystal''' was a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|Lightsaber crystal]] that could be found in the [[Ultimate FX Gungan lightsaber]].

==Behind the scenes==
Players on [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Clone Wars Adventures'']] could obtain this item by going to JointheJedi.com and clicking on the ''Clone Wars Adventures'' icon. The crystal gives lightsabers a bubble effect.
